crowd_sentiment_addition: Aquatic, Serene. Dreamy, liberating dance-pop, euphoric and self-liberating, evoking peak Britney/Madonna energy - reinforces the weightless, ethereal isolation of the tagged scene
Dreams and Hope, Anthem. Beloved ARMY comfort/unity anthem - 'each person is their own universe,' used as a concert closer - reinforces the awe/belonging of the tagged scene
Serene, Cinematic. Dreamy romantic homage to falling in love, fan-favorite live song - reinforces the warm, unhurried road-trip freedom in the tagged scene
Carefree, Euphoric. Celebratory carpe-diem party anthem, upbeat and communal - reinforces the carefree euphoria of the tag
Euphoric, Romantic. Euphoric dance track widely read as genuinely romantic despite the EDM production - reinforces the euphoric/romantic pairing
Y2K Nostalgia, Cyberpunk. Defiant glossy synth-pop about the danger/allure of fame, self-aware ambition as a weapon, explicit Y2K/Sheila E. references - reinforces the Y2K/cyberpunk tag directly
Happy / Festive, Optimistic. Upbeat euphoric cross-cultural dance track; the Sheeran/Singh blend feels magical and goosebump-inducing - reinforces the happy/festive tag
Youth Nostalgia, Melancholic Euphoria. Bittersweet nostalgia for an ex, uplifting and hopeful but sad at times - reinforces the melancholic euphoria tag precisely
Peak Nostalgia, Bitter-Sweet. Dreamy aching nostalgia for lost love, hazy memories fading while the feeling stays - reinforces the bittersweet nostalgia tag
Hopeful, Uplifting. Warm hopeful anthem about wanting real love over superhero fantasy - reinforces the hopeful/uplifting tag
Serene, Carefree. Whimsical coming-of-age love song, vulnerable and adoring, gently anxious not sad - reinforces serene/carefree

Serene, Introspective. Crowd sentiment adds real weight here - fans describe crying to it, longing and loss for someone gone, calling it haunting - strengthens the introspective side of the tag with a stronger emotional undertow than 'serene' alone suggests
Nocturnal, Atmospheric. Sultry uncertain push-and-pull romance, passionate but restless - reinforces the nocturnal/atmospheric tag
Wistful Nostalgia, Tender. Iconic tender bittersweet love ballad, one of the most-played wedding songs of its era - reinforces wistful nostalgia/tender
Post-Breakup Grief, Somber. Bittersweet nostalgia for an ended relationship, fondly missing someone despite a messy ending - reinforces post-breakup grief
Unrequited Love, Quietly Devastated. Iconic unrequited-love/jealousy ballad, described everywhere as tender heartbreak and 'sad aesthetic' - reinforces the tag strongly
Despondent Longing, Reminiscent. Haunting regret over a lost relationship, used constantly in breakup/melancholy contexts - reinforces despondent longing
Adrenaline Drive, Nocturnal Intensity. Chaotic, paranoid, unsettling track with obsessive energy - reinforces adrenaline drive/nocturnal intensity
Post-Breakup Anger, Smoldering Longing. Heartbreak and resentment after a breakup, moving on but still hurting - reinforces post-breakup anger
Club Dance Euphoria, Carefree Frenzy. Pure upbeat party/dance track, no emotional depth - reinforces club dance euphoria/carefree frenzy directly
Crush Butterflies, Giddy Late Night. Playful crush/butterflies pop song with a jealous streak - reinforces crush butterflies/giddy late night

Quiet Introspective Evening, Window-Side Chill. Sweet joyful love song about music and a partner - confirms the quiet mood is warm/content, not melancholic, strengthening the chill/introspective (not sad) reading

Futuristic Club Build, 90s Deep House Nostalgia. Corrected artist match (ENHYPEN, not American Authors) - driving synthetic bassline built to feel like a video-game soundtrack, a high-energy competitive battle cry - strongly reinforces the futuristic club build tag
Observational Stillness, Time Drifting. Contemplative, melancholic, existential reflection - reinforces observational stillness/time drifting
Cosmic Nocturnal Drift, Philosophical Loneliness. Melancholic isolation in space, bittersweet not triumphant - reinforces cosmic nocturnal drift/philosophical loneliness
Contented Solitude, Cozy Café. Intimate, tender, quietly romantic acoustic love song - reinforces contented solitude/cozy café
Intense Yearning, 90s Heartwrenching. Iconic vulnerable ballad about wanting to be truly seen, aching and emotional - reinforces intense yearning/90s heartwrenching

Puerto Rican Coastal Morning, Sun-Soaked Calm. A vibrant celebration of island life - hugs, coffee, watching the sun set together, unplugging from phones - reinforces the sun-soaked calm/coastal tag precisely

Nostalgic Regret, Afro-Puerto Rican Melancholy. Viral for its raw regret over not taking more photos/spending more time with loved ones now gone - sparked a global tearful tribute trend, reinforces nostalgic regret strongly

Liberating Heartbreak, Euphoric Moving On. Upbeat pop that masks real heartbreak underneath - nostalgia, jealousy, and acceptance dancing away the pain - reinforces liberating heartbreak/euphoric moving on exactly
Liberated Nightlife, Neon Drive. Reggaeton anthem celebrating single independence, neon nightclub bachelorette energy - reinforces liberated nightlife/neon drive directly
Futuristic Lounge Chill, Head-Bop Groove. Reggae-dancehall attraction/desire track with a sensual chill groove - reinforces the lounge chill/head-bop tag

Aquatic Ethereal, Underwater Dreamscape. Romantic escapism theme (sailing with the wind, sky, breeze) reinforces the ethereal/dreamlike quality of the tag, though the song's own imagery leans toward air and sky rather than water
Haunted Nocturnal Loneliness, Ambient Despair. Described everywhere as haunting - unresolved heartbreak, guilt, and lingering pain between exes - reinforces haunted nocturnal loneliness strongly

artist: benny blanco, J Balvin, Selena Gomez, Tainy
crowd_sentiment_addition: Playful Bouncy Joy, Whimsical. Chill, flirty, hypnotic track about mutual obsession - playful pajama-party music video - reinforces playful bouncy joy/whimsical
Hypnotic Groove, Suspicious Cool. Hypnotic rhythm with confident, seductive, in-control swagger - reinforces hypnotic groove/suspicious cool exactly
Morning Beach Dance, Sun-Soaked Carefree. Tropical, warm-weather, hip-swaying dancehall - reinforces morning beach dance/sun-soaked carefree
Latin Club Night, Possessive Romance. Possessive love proclamation set at a block party - reinforces latin club night/possessive romance directly

Rainy Day, Cozy. Warm intimate 2020 solo release, jazzy ballad written as a letter to fans (ARMY) during pandemic isolation - fans describe it as comforting, tender, and 'like a warm hug' - reinforces the rainy-day cozy tag directly

Quiet Loneliness, Introspective Melancholy. Depicts depression and anxiety, crushing and heartbreaking - a pandemic-era isolation anthem - reinforces quiet loneliness/introspective melancholy precisely

Isolated Loneliness, Existential Yearning. Widely known as BTS's loneliest-whale metaphor song, consistently described by fans as being about isolation, feeling unheard, and the ache of wanting connection - reinforces isolated loneliness/existential yearning exactly

Socially Exhausted Joy, Burnout Masked as Party. Deceptively euphoric - upbeat dance-challenge hit built on ennui, stress, and using music to fake being okay - reinforces socially exhausted joy/burnout masked as party almost word for word

Dystopian Rave, Chaotic High Energy. Best-selling Korean single of 2015, brash chaotic comeback anthem with a military/lawless-world lyrical theme and trap-EDM production - reinforces dystopian rave/chaotic high energy

Deceptively Joyful Drive, Quirky Carefree. OST special track from It's Okay to Not Be Okay (2020) - upbeat self-liberation anthem urging the listener to 'let go of your inner you' and shake off overthinking - reinforces deceptively joyful drive/quirky carefree well, playful energy with a freeing undertone rather than heavy subject matter

First Love Euphoria, Ethereal Butterflies. One of BTS's most beloved solo tracks - pure, light, uplifting happiness of falling in love, dreamlike and bright - reinforces first love euphoria/ethereal butterflies directly

Hopeful Passionate Love, Vibrant EDM Energy. Passionate and hopeful about giving love a chance - an upbeat, vibrant EDM collab received with excitement - reinforces the hopeful passion/vibrant EDM energy tag directly
High-Energy Yearning, Nostalgic Bounce. Soaring EDM anthem about devotion and vulnerability in love - uplifting yet tinged with nostalgia - reinforces high-energy yearning/nostalgic bounce

Confident Solo Concert, Jazzy Domestic Warmth. Partial mismatch: crowd sentiment centers on ARMY-as-home comfort and loneliness-despite-fame rather than solo-concert confidence - the warmth and domestic side of the tag fits, but confident solo concert undersells the song's core theme of feeling adrift until returning to loved ones

Golden Hour Drive, Sunlit Bittersweet. Captures the fleeting magic of a specific sunset moment - bittersweet, nostalgic yearning mixed with youthful wonder, happiness tinged with sadness - reinforces golden hour drive/sunlit bittersweet

Velvety Aquatic Freshness, Dreamy Hairwash. A 90s remake, charming and enchanting - romantic infatuation with an idealized, comforting figure - reinforces the dreamy, velvety-soft romantic quality of the tag, though the fairy/love metaphor carries more weight than literal hairwash imagery

Magical Duality, Angelic to Demonic Arc. Part of TXT's dark storyline - loneliness and growing distance shift into a nightmarish, tempo-flipping second half - reinforces magical duality/angelic-to-demonic arc directly

Optimistic Progression, Serene. War 2 duet - mixed but largely positive fan reaction calling it visually beautiful and romantically charged ('chartbuster material'), though some felt the heavy Punjabi lyrics diluted emotional connection - broadly reinforces optimistic progression/serene, with a slightly more urgent romantic edge than 'serene' alone suggests

Sweetly Yearning, Romantic. Raabta ballad - lyrics are a gentle, pleading call for a beloved to 'come once' - consistently read as tender, devoted longing - reinforces sweetly yearning/romantic exactly
Carefree, Nightlife. Dhurandhar dance track capturing unrestrained nocturnal celebration - carefree youth living in the moment - reinforces carefree/nightlife directly
Uninhibited Celebration, Carefree. Jab We Met classic - a joyful celebration of being happy and in love, high valence by design - reinforces uninhibited celebration/carefree precisely
Wanderlust, New Beginnings. Yeh Jawaani Hai Deewani travel anthem - captures wanderlust, freedom, and youthful exuberance - reinforces wanderlust/new beginnings directly

Joyful Companionship, Journey Energy. Highway ballad - an anthem of deep companionship between two people on a journey together, tender and devoted - reinforces joyful companionship/journey energy precisely

Melancholic Yearning, Optimistic Undertone. Ludo track - explicitly described by reviewers as melancholic, frustrated, and vulnerable, torn between wanting to be 'ruined' or made whole by love - reinforces melancholic yearning, with the pleading 'aabaad' side supplying the optimistic undertone
Euphoric Love, Morning Optimism. Jab We Met item number - captures the exhilarating, intoxicating rush of first love with joyful, playful energy - reinforces euphoric love/morning optimism directly

Big Fat Indian Wedding, Festive Frenzy. Jab We Met wedding-dance number - pure high-energy joy, still played at weddings/celebrations decades later, with strong Sonu Nigam/Javed Ali vocal chemistry - reinforces big fat Indian wedding/festive frenzy directly

Rain-Soaked Romance, Euphoric Butterflies. Jab We Met fan-favorite - expresses deep emotional dependence and devotion, life feeling brighter and more alive because of the person - reinforces the romantic/euphoric side of the tag, though the song itself has no rain imagery in its lyrics or reception

Sunset Party, Breezy Euphoria. Roy party anthem - explicitly described by its own writers as a carefree, self-centered 'forget your worries and dance' club track, chart-topping and widely loved - reinforces sunset party/breezy euphoria directly

artist: KK, Yo Yo Honey Singh, Shefali Alvares
crowd_sentiment_addition: Main Character Night Out, Carefree Euphoria. Race 2 club anthem - straightforward high-energy party lyrics (drinks, dancing, Saturday night) with no deeper layer - reinforces main character night out/carefree euphoria as a literal, uncomplicated party song

Carefree Group Energy, Breezy Morning. Title track described by critics as a 'peppy,' 'youthful,' instant-hit number with Dadlani 'letting himself loose' vocally - reinforces carefree group energy directly

Breezy Romance, Carefree Flirtation. Shuddh Desi Romance song about Jaipur, the pink city - playful, sensory imagery of everything ('me, you, the day') being pink - reinforces breezy romance/carefree flirtation directly, no darker undertone found

Rajasthani Desert Evening, Chill Indie. Mismatched Season 2 (Netflix) track - a warm, quiet-joy welcome song for a loved one's return, set in a Rajasthani/desert folk register - reinforces Rajasthani desert evening/chill indie directly

Rainy Evening Romance, Acoustic Heartstring. Love Aaj Kal (2020) lead single - captures the innocence, hope, and unspoken uncertainty of first love, a soulful, timeless favorite - reinforces acoustic heartstring/tender romance strongly, though rain imagery isn't a documented part of its reception

Divine Nostalgic Love, Happy Rainy. A blend of romantic and spiritual elements built on a devotional-style refrain offering everything up to a beloved, in an almost Sufi register - reinforces divine nostalgic love directly; rain imagery is not a documented part of its reception

Love in Shared Glances, Chill Evening Drive. A celebration of love set over slinky electronic beats, recreated from Shobha Gurtu's classical thumri and drawing listeners back to the original - reinforces love in shared glances through its warm classical-electronic blend

Night Bike Ride Euphoria, Wildly In Love. A euphoric, adrenaline-rush new-age romantic track, with a music video built around adventure sports like skydiving and kite-surfing - reinforces night bike ride euphoria and wildly in love directly

Big Fat Indian Wedding, Festive. Repeatedly described by fans as a wedding banger, with brides dancing to it at their own weddings; lyrics center on mehndi and marriage vows - reinforces big fat Indian wedding and festive strongly
Balcony Chill, Observational Contentment. A Gujarati-language track from the 2018 film Sharato Lagu; limited discourse available beyond release credits, so crowd sentiment could not be confirmed

Nostalgic Romance, Quiet Evening. A widely streamed, well-loved romantic duet about building a world for just two, remade from Akhil's Punjabi song Khaab - reinforces nostalgic romance through its devoted, wistful declaration of love
Summer Crush Butterflies, Chill Drive. An indie-pop track released in both full and acoustic versions; limited discourse available beyond release details, so crowd sentiment could not be confirmed

Desi Nightclub Glow, Neon Urban Energy. From Cocktail's party-and-nightlife-centric soundtrack, with bilingual Hindi and English verses reflecting the film's global-Indian club setting - reinforces desi nightclub glow and neon urban energy through its film context

Tropical Beach Romance, Breezy Lovey-Dovey. Winner of the 2024 Filmfare Award for Best Female Playback Singer Telugu, a major commercial and critical success with romantic, danceable choreography - reinforces tropical beach romance and breezy lovey-dovey strongly

Chill Indie Euphoria, South Indian Evening Breeze. Received a highly positive response that significantly expanded the artist's fanbase, and became a cultural phenomenon fueling reels and viral clips - reinforces chill indie euphoria directly

Tropical Village Chill, Indie R&B. Became the most-searched Tamil song of its year and a global viral sensation on Spotify and TikTok, built on a folk-and-jazz dancefloor-friendly groove - reinforces tropical village chill and indie R&B through its folk-informed identity

Full-Energy Dance Release, Carefree. Its hook-step went viral worldwide with fan dance covers across India and abroad, fueled by Mahesh Babu's dialogue rendition and Sreeleela's dancing - reinforces full-energy dance release and carefree strongly

Mellow Romantic Intensity, Quiet Love. A tender song of devotion and intimacy built around awe at a beloved's beauty, a long-running Tamil romantic favorite - reinforces mellow romantic intensity and quiet love

Carnatic Dance Floor, Mass Energy. From the 2013 film Neram, became a viral hit among youngsters as part of a soundtrack that drew positive reviews from critics - reinforces mass energy and youthful dancefloor appeal

artist: M. M. Keeravani ft. Rahul Sipligunj
crowd_sentiment_addition: Explosive Folk Dance, Triumphant. Won the 2023 Oscar for Best Original Song and a Golden Globe, introduced at the ceremony as an irresistibly catchy chorus with electrifying beats and killer dance moves - reinforces explosive folk dance and triumphant emphatically

Mass Cinema Hype, Festival Energy. A fan anthem for Fahadh Faasil's character in Aavesham, with widespread commercial success and numerous fan covers and hook-step recreations - reinforces mass cinema hype and festival energy. Composer credit note: most sources attribute this song to Sushin Shyam rather than Thaman S.
Elegant Dance Confidence, Carnatic Grace. Attained popularity as a South Indian wedding standard, even among diaspora communities abroad - reinforces elegant dance confidence strongly

Folk Dance Euphoria, Triumphant. A burst of romantic energy from Sai Abhyankar's Think Indie catalogue, with lyrics of wedding drums and blooming forests - reinforces folk dance euphoria and triumphant directly

Celestial, Serene. A heartfelt folk song and passionate, playful declaration of a lover's restless chase through village lanes - a livelier, rustic-romantic mood than celestial and serene suggests; possible mismatch

Nostalgia, Comforting. A generations-spanning cultural touchstone from Tagore to Meghani to Gujarati folk to Bollywood, still central to Navratri garba nights and described by listeners decades later as capturing the sweetness of the Gujarati language - reinforces nostalgia and comforting strongly

Hopeful Romantic Nostalgia, Poetic Longing. The singer's most soulful work, built on a pleading, yearning refrain asking a beloved to come and drench the heart - reinforces hopeful romantic nostalgia and poetic longing directly
Soft Breezy Love, Cool Evening Serenity. Limited discourse available beyond release credits, so crowd sentiment could not be confirmed

Rural Monsoon Parting Grief, Petrichor Nostalgia. A classic Kaag Baapu folk poem about a woman longing for a beloved who must travel away as monsoon clouds gather, described by listeners as having captured hearts with its soulful melody and profound lyrics - reinforces rural monsoon parting grief and petrichor nostalgia directly
Monsoon Romantic Nostalgia, Krishna Flute Ethereal. Limited discourse available beyond release credits and a later reprise version, so crowd sentiment could not be confirmed

New Beginnings, Hopeful Opposites in Love. Resonates with themes of duality and connection through a bird metaphor, embracing contradiction as essential to love - reinforces new beginnings and hopeful opposites in love directly

Moonlit Romantic Reverie, Carefree Love. The most loved love anthem in its soundtrack, celebrated after 2000 days in cinemas as a timeless melody that continues to capture hearts - reinforces moonlit romantic reverie and carefree love strongly

Youth Fading Nostalgia, Bittersweet Acceleration. Built around the refrain that beauty arrives today but fades tomorrow, explicitly framed by listeners as a meditation on the fleeting, transitory nature of youth and love - reinforces youth fading nostalgia and bittersweet acceleration directly

Divine Love, Krishna Ethereal. A soulful Gujarati devotional song built on traditional instruments like flute and shehnai, rooted in Radha-Krishna imagery - reinforces divine love and Krishna ethereal directly

Overwhelming Love, Heart Full to Bursting. A popular Gujarati love song about searching for someone who feels lost yet still close to the heart, with the beloved framed as a source of light amid darkness - reinforces overwhelming love and heart full to bursting directly

Playful Devotional Joy, Krishna Mischief. Set to lyrics by revered Bhakti poet Narsinh Mehta, a celebration of devotion and playful imagination steeped in Krishna-Radha mythology, blurring the line between song and bhajan - reinforces playful devotional joy and Krishna mischief emphatically
True Love Eyes Closed, Sunlit Inner Peace. A beautiful song that touches the heart, built around emotions of love and longing - reinforces true love eyes closed and sunlit inner peace

Yearning and Waiting, Cloudy Evening Emotion. Stormed the Gujarati music scene with timeless, eternal appeal; its core message is a woman's longing and waiting to reunite with her beloved - reinforces yearning and waiting and cloudy evening emotion directly

Monsoon Melancholy, Petrichor Nostalgia. A poetic monsoon love song enriched with the evocative strains of the sarangi, where rain becomes a symbol of unity between lovers - reinforces monsoon melancholy and petrichor nostalgia directly

Hopeful Morning Love, Early Drive Warmth. Fuses Rajasthani and Gujarati folk influences into an uplifting love song, a playful, sparkling expression of love - reinforces hopeful morning love and early drive warmth

Wedding Mehndi Joy, Folk-EDM Celebration. A fresh rendition of a traditional Gujarati folk track celebrating the mehndi ceremony of an Indian wedding, elevating both festiveness and emotion - reinforces wedding mehndi joy and folk-EDM celebration directly

Forever Together Promise, Nostalgic Devotion. Described in its own release as a precious song of Gujarati music heritage synonymous with the very definition of love - reinforces forever together promise and nostalgic devotion directly

Playful Morning Energy, Modern Folk Brightness. A traditional garba and dandiya composition with a brass arrangement from Aditya Gadhvi's non-stop garba catalogue - its upbeat, festive dance context reinforces playful morning energy and modern folk brightness

Desert Storytelling Night, Rann of Kutch Magical. From Coke Studio Bharat, honors the 600-year legacy of the Agariya salt farmers of the Rann of Kutch, built on the paradox of finding sweetness in hardship, following the earlier viral hit Khalasi - reinforces desert storytelling night and Rann of Kutch magical precisely

Vrindavan Dawn Ethereal, Divine Awakening. Part of a dedicated devotional Krishna-song catalogue by the artist, its title referencing Krishna's butter-thief epithet - its devotional, mythological framing reinforces Vrindavan dawn ethereal and divine awakening

song: Bhajan Vina Maari Bhuk Nai Bhaage
crowd_sentiment_addition: Devotional Drive, Fresh Folk Morning. A superhit Gujarati bhajan, with lyrics built around a soul-hunger that only devotional singing to Ram can satisfy - reinforces devotional drive and fresh folk morning directly

Fresh Beginnings, Optimistic Love. From the Saiyaara 2025 soundtrack, singled out by critics as a standout, beautifully shot track; lyrics center on a lover's steadying presence bringing calm and new mornings - reinforces fresh beginnings and optimistic love directly
